Stable signing key: from this version on, every release is signed with the same key, so new versions install as updates.

**One last uninstall needed:** v2.6 and older were signed with a different key, so uninstall the old Meow Solver once, then install v2.7. Future versions will update over it normally. Re-enable the accessibility service after installing.

Includes v2.6: X's are placed with drags and verified afterwards.

Install: download **MeowSolver-v2.7.apk** below, then follow the Setup steps in the README. Android 11+.

Source: see README for build steps.
